title: test
description: Stage output contract: tests run + the test-validate self-report (the 'verify' half). tests_meaningful is required so a codex runner that omits it is a SCHEMA_VIOLATION (the schema-enforced form of the engine's fail-open gate).

failures.description: ids of failing tests (empty when green)

tests_meaningful.description: true only if the tests genuinely exercise the change (would fail if it regressed)

validation_notes.description: what the tests assert / any gaps
